• the male lion must not be placed in the same enclosure as the deer
• for the female lion to be placed with the male lion, another animal must be with them too
• the monkey cannot be in the same enclosure as the lions and the tiger
• the zebra cannot be left alone in an enclosure, but also cannot be with more than one other animal
Based on the above restrictions alone, which of the following animals can be placed in the same enclosure as the male and female lion?
